answer: Distance-bounded location attestation: each identity answers challenges from three fixed verifiers at separated sites within a speed-of-light round-trip bound plus a local sensor signature. A single operator cannot satisfy far-apart sites in one epoch. One verifier enclosure uses a vine-mounted humidity sensor. Another uses a canyon wind gauge. A third reads light angles through a prism. Faking one identity costs a powered transceiver, unique key, and maintained link at that site; faking N requires N physical installations.
